content_sections.body: Work without notes first. For the situation 'reviewing plans and invitations', say one sentence that meets this goal: Review plan, reason, invitation, and response language. Then check the model: 'I can state a plan, invite someone, and respond politely to an invitation.' Identify one word or phrase that makes the message clear.
content_sections.title: Recall and select (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Give one clear response for reviewing plans and invitations, then ask a partner one follow-up question. Compare the response with the model and repair one missing time, reason, place, quantity, or next step. Use the whole unit's familiar language rather than memorising one sentence.
content_sections.title: Compare two responses (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Before the unit test, check three things: the main message is clear, one useful detail is included, and the listener knows what happens next. Say or write a new short message about a similar situation, not the model about reviewing plans and invitations.
content_sections.title: Self-check and transfer (6 minutes)
